title: Send reminder covers one asset, updates last sent, no Resend
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. A worklist row whose customer has the setting "Maintenance notifications" on, a preferred contact on the asset, and a contact with an email address.
  4. Give the test customer's contact an email address you can open (e.g. your own work email), so the reminder lands in your inbox.
  5. The customer has a second enrolled asset with a row on the worklist.
custom_steps:
1. Open the row's Contact card; read the send control and look for any Resend.
  2. Press Send reminder; read the dialog that opens and which unit its reminder covers.
  3. Send it; read the confirmation and the card again.
  4. Open your inbox and read the reminder email and the units it lists.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The control reads "Send reminder"; there is no Resend.
  • The application's existing send email dialog opens, covering this asset only; the customer's other asset is not in it.
  • After sending, a confirmation appears and the card reads "Last sent" with today's date.
  • One email arrived in your inbox, about this asset only. The audit entry a send writes cannot be checked by hand in v1 — no screen shows the audit. Pass or fail on what you can see, and write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Nothing on the card or the row shows whether the customer opened the email.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10571 (S14, Contact the customer from a row), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S14 (S14-R4 to S14-R6, S14-E2, S14-E3); Plan 2 — The work order and the customer — Technical Implementation Plan, section 3 Frontend decisions, FD-216; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-R5: “The send control reads Send reminder. Nothing is emailed automatically in v1, so there is no Resend”
  • S14-R4: “Send reminder sends the email of S19 for that one asset, with its current state, through the application's existing send email dialog, per S19-R3”
  • Plan 2 §3 FD-216: “After a send: toast "Reminder sent." and "Last sent {date}"”
  • S14-R6: “A send from a row will cover that one asset only, never the customer's other units”
  • S14-E2: “Sending a reminder writes an audit entry and updates last sent”
  • S21-N3: “No screen shows the audit in v1”
  • S14-E3: “Read receipts are not tracked”
